VDZ infant concentrations compared with maternal serum drug concentration
cohort: The study included 1,669 completed singleton pregnancies from women with a diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease, resulting in 1,610 live births.
finding: In utero exposure to vedolizumab (VDZ) or ustekinumab (UST) did not show an increased risk of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes, including spontaneous abortion, congenital malformations, and serious infections, while ustekinumab (UST) exposure was associated with a lower rate of preterm birth.
